messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: You and your healthcare provider should decide if you will take Atorvastatin or breastfeed.
You should not take atorvastatin if you breastfeed.
Talk to your healthcare provider about the best way to feed your baby if you take LIPITOR.
Triplet: ["Atorvastatin", "has breastfeeding warning", "should not take if breastfeeding"]

The relation 'has breastfeeding warning' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is associated with a caution or warning regarding its use in patients who are breastfeeding.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has pregnancy or breastfeeding warning': The subject drug carries the warning specified by the object entity regarding use during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
B. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
C. 'has pregnancy registry': The subject drug is associated with a registry that collects health information about pregnant individuals and their babies exposed to the drug.
D. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
E. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
